ruleDefinitions.name: System Network Discovery - macOS
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects enumeration of local network configuration

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/arp$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/ifconfig$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/netstat$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/networksetup$") OR process_path = RGX("\\/socketfilterfw$")) OR (process_path = "\/usr\/bin\/defaults" AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/Library\\/Preferences\\/com\\\.apple\\\.alf.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*read.*")))) AND  NOT (parent_process_path = RGX("\\/wifivelocityd$"))
